description: FinLens helps users research Vietnam's listed equities and financial markets in ChatGPT. It retrieves company, price, and intraday data; compares financial statements, peers, and valuation; and analyzes flows, technical signals, funds, bonds, warrants, dividends, macro data, news, and broker research. It is informational research only and does not execute trades or provide personalized investment advice.
